item.title: Buttertv Presents: the Metrocard Classic 2025
item.description: September 4th-7th 2025. New York City - Following up after 2023’s success is no easy task especially when the most uncontrollable variable happens: RAIN… and lots of it. Two days out of four isn’t too bad considering the forecast said rain all week. The first day was the DSTRY Popup where Reverse Halo was premiered as well as a photo exhibit.

item.title: Bobi Spassov - T I M E - Inferno Skates
item.description: An Inferno Skates Video. Rider: Bobi Spassov. Camera: Kalleo Hipolito. Edit: Bobi Spassov. Music: Sinnerella - Eyes Without a Face. Visit Infernoskate.com.

item.title: Mesmer - Cantrip Jazz
item.description: Mesmer is proud to host “Cantrip Jazz”. Filmed over a few weeks in the early spring of 2022, the film has laid dormant until now. Cantrip Jazz is a short unhinged film accidentally created by Dominic Bruce, Oliver Love (Oli Short) & Tom Sharman. It features two skaters of different generations each having inspired the other at different points in time. Adopting the philosophy of jazz as a way of responding to each other. item.title: 'KHOYA' - FURTIUS IN MOROCCO
item.description: In Arabic, especially Maghrebi dialects, “Khoya” (خويا) means “my brother,” a colloquial term used endearingly for a close friend. Filmed in Casablanca & Rabat. A film by: Teles Angel. Starring: Iván Aliaga, Peter Eberlein, Carles Durich, Ferran Laparra, Teles Angel & Hamza Koudri. Photography by: David Serrano. Furtius 2025.

item.title: Judith Ivorra Perles (10, Spain) - Edit
item.description: Judith Ivorra Perles, at only 10 years old, is the 2025 Spanish Street and Park Champion, third place in the 2025 Spanish Vert Championship, and the 2025 Valencian Community Champion in Street, Park, and Vert. A film by: Colorins Productions.

item.title: Bodega Boys X Them Skates Nyc
item.description: Bodega Boys and Them Skates NYC team up for a vibrant blading session. The video captures the energy of urban skating with diverse locations and stylish moves. Enjoy the fast-paced cuts and catchy soundtrack. Camera: Jeremy Raff, Mike Torres, Augusto Castillo. Edit: Mike Torres. Graphics: Augusto Castillo. Color: Edwin Rodriguez. Sound: Harry Abel. Music: Kedr Livanskiy, Shoc Corridor, Toxe, 070 Shake.

item.title: Korey Waikiki - Still in Line - A Razors Video by Nico Sotomayor
item.description: Still in line, but we moved up a space. Korey Waikiki is still in line after 2 decades. Shot & Chopped by Nico Sotomayor as a sequel to Next in Line (PLAY). Korey is still dropping heat while holding his space. Contributing footage: Tais Colares #Rollerblading #inlineskating #sports #nextinline #razors. Song and artist: Help by Del and Amp Live.

item.title: Mike French (California) - The Show Goes On, a video by Hawke Trackler
item.description: “I met up with Mike in California for 10 days to hang out and film some skating. It was first gonna be for something more special to us but Mike French blasted his ribs the day before I got there and then it rained the first 3 days. We made it work though and had a great experience beyond mikes ribs hurting some times”. - Hawke Trackler.

item.title: David and Alex. David Sizemore, Alex Broskow - Dead Wheels
item.description: David Sizemore & Alex Broskow - Kansas City, MO 2026. David and Alex from Dead Wheels showcase impressive blading skills. The pair navigate urban landscapes, tackling various obstacles. Their journey includes both triumphs and falls, offering a raw glimpse into their skating style. Song: Fabulous Friend - The Field Mice.
